item.title: Friday Favorites 32
item.description:
Happy Friday,

Cue the music, brew that pot. I took a month off writing and vacationed in Italy and Greece. I drank a bunch of wine, reserved a car on the wrong continent, and loved seeing a bunch of ancient Greek ruins. Now Minnesota is dark and cold — but at least the Great Horned Owls have ousted the Barred Owls from the copse of trees across the street.

item.title: Reading books in days, not weeks
item.description:
I love reading a book that’s so good you start and finish it in a day or two.

I stayed up late on a lake vacation reading Peter Heller’s “The River” because I had to know whether the two friends would safely escape a wildfire on their wilderness canoe trip even as they paddled closer to the fire to investigate a missing person.
